title: Minimum Number of Moves to Make Palindrome
goal: Form a palindrome using the fewest adjacent swaps.
strategy: Pair the leftmost unsettled letter with its rightmost available match and bubble that match to the right boundary. If the letter has no partner, move it one step toward the center and retry.
